name: model-fit
description: Before the first real task of a session, a quick Haiku check asks whether the session model fits it, on four tiers: Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable. On a mismatch you get a Switch or Stay dialog before anything runs. It respects your cap and your availableModels setting and, in auto, probes each model once a day; a transient error counts as available.

highestModel.title: Highest model
highestModel.description: The strongest model model-fit may suggest. auto: check which models your plan and settings allow, and never suggest one you can't use. Pick a cap (fable, opus, sonnet, haiku) if your plan lacks a model or you want to cost-limit suggestions.
